hero.title: The right ERP fit for your finance team
hero.lede: Based on how your multi-entity finance team works today, here is the one setup we would start with and why.
pick.title: Multi-Entity Consolidation
pick.body: One consolidated view across every entity, with automatic intercompany eliminations so your close stops depending on spreadsheets.

item-2.title: Closes faster every month

item-3.title: Proven with peers
item-3.body: Companies like yours consolidated hundreds of entities on one platform.
